note: Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 2 states that miracles and prophecies, since they clearly show God's omnipotence and infinite knowledge, are most certain signs of revelation suited to everyone's understanding. The premise states a sufficient condition: whoever can reveal with signs that only God can give reveals recognizably. The council speaks of the actual revelation, not of a general capacity, and the exclusivity ('only God can give') is the analyst's reading of 'clearly show omnipotence' (as in REL-DEI-FILIUS-SIGNS-SUPPORTS-SOME-SIGNS-ONLY-GOD-CAN-GIVE).
